name: Geometry Dash Archipelago
description: Play Geometry Dash in an Archipelago multiworld: levels and coins send checks automatically, locked levels and gamemodes are enforced, items and traps arrive in game.

server.name: Server
server.description: The room address from archipelago.gg, like archipelago.gg:53092. The port changes when a sleeping room restarts.

slot.name: Slot name
slot.description: Your player name from your GeometryDash.yaml.

password.name: Room password
password.description: Leave empty if the room has none.

lock-levels.name: Lock levels you haven't unlocked
lock-levels.description: Trying to play one shows what it needs and returns you to the menu.

lock-gamemodes.name: Lock gamemodes you haven't unlocked
lock-gamemodes.description: Touching a portal for a gamemode you don't have kills you.
